1. Why 5m Wall-TC Averages & Off-Line QC Fail Carbon-Fiber Lines
• PAN Nitrile Cyclization Exotherm (-1,650 kJ/kg) & Tow Fire:
Bundled 50K PAN filaments in 260°C oxidation ovens trap exothermic
heat (+1.85°C/s to 274.2°C). 5-min wall thermocouples read 255°C
bulk air until the tow auto-ignites (>450°C), burning all 200 parallel
tows and releasing toxic hydrogen cyanide (HCN) gas.
• 1,500°C Labyrinth-Seal O2 Ingress & Weibull Strength Collapse:
A 15 Pa draft dip lets 14.8 ppm O2 enter the 1,500°C carbonization
muffle, etching nanoscale surface pits that crash tensile strength
from 7.0 GPa (T1100G aerospace grade) to <5.4 GPa.
